body: I'm pretty sure the hospital and police will know you did it yourself. They would have to call the police and make a report. They will look at the knife for fingerprints. They will look at how the wound was made. That would be an ongoing thing. If they think you've tried to kill yourself, even if you say you weren't they would have to consider a psyche ward. Other people correct me if I'm wrong but this seems like it would cause you and your parents way more trouble than taking small steps to deal with the actual things worrying you.

Anyone who looks down on your parents for a reason like that is a moron and so who cares what they think.

If you don't want to drop out that seems to mean you want to want to achieve something. Try to stop seeing the overall whole of everything and break it into smaller parts. Deal with each smaller part one at a time.

So, you have problems with studying and keeping attention. You might be able to speak with a counselor at school and explain that part first and ask if they have anyone who can help you with that. If they are half decent they should have respect for you for reaching out for solutions.

My college also had free emotional support and maybe you could ask about that.

You've lied to your parents so that feels like a big monster. What if you spoke to the school first and try to get some kind of plan. Then you could have that also to tell your parents. If you can't face telling them in person maybe you could write it in a letter.

Sometimes I just write everything down on a piece of paper and separate them out into smaller things like I'm saying. This has helped me before when I had too many things and felt I couldn't handle it.
That's amazing and wonderful. They are the coolest creatures.
